Changes in this application: normalized scale and orientation; adjusted paint and lighting; regrouped native engine, doors, wheels, hood, roof and rear panel for exploded presentation. Added a schematic tank/fuel component to illustrate context. Original model remains unmodified in car-concept.glb.

The model is a realistic concept car, not an exact production make or service manual.
